goal: Make Linux release binaries portable across distributions with older glibc or alternative C libraries
Allow non-GUI executables to run out of the box on systems like Alpine Linux and NixOS without extra shims
agreement: Unaddressed objection: static glibc NSS resolvers break on host shared libraries (luke-jr)
Diagnostic logging suggested for empty DNS lookups when external NSS resolution fails (xrviv)
Extensively tested on Alpine, NixOS, Fedora, and older Ubuntu installations (dergoegge, jsarenik, 0xB10C)
Supports using glibc static-pie as more auditable than moving to musl (theuni)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it allows release binaries to run across non-glibc and older Linux distributions
Eliminates the need for dynamic linker shims on platforms like Alpine Linux and NixOS
Resolves long-standing portability limitations for users across diverse Linux environments
